Human dignity is non-negotiable.

I am Shivratan Kumar, founder of Aasra India Welfare Foundation. Aasra was built on one belief: every person deserves to be treated with dignity, whatever their circumstances.

Too many people fall into the gap between systemic neglect and real help. Aasra bridges that gap with grassroots action. We provide essential food, shelter and vital care to the underserved, and we turn immediate relief into sustainable pathways out of vulnerability.

Shivratan Kumar, Founder

Four ways we serve.

Education School kits, tuition, scholarships

Free classes, school bags, books and scholarships so that no child leaves school for lack of fees or supplies.

Free health camps, medicines and hygiene awareness for families who cannot easily reach a clinic.

Ration kits and cooked meals for families facing hunger, with extra support during festivals and emergencies.
